text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I don't want to lose—I don't want to lose,
I don't want to lose... Not even to you!!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Waaaahhhhh!!!!
—Haaaaahhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A-A massive roar!
What an incredible roar from the crowd here at Kyoto Racecourse!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)—
A generous round of applause is pouring out
for the Umamusume who put up such a fierce fight!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Fan
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, Kitasan Black---!!
That was incredible! What an insane run!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
Chevaaaal!! Way to gooo!!
You were so cool, Cheva-kーーun!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
Show us another race like that!!
We'll be cheering for youuuuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ......Ahaha—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Heh... Haha.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Amazing!!
It feels like we're in the middle of a giant festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My heart is thumpingâthump-thump!
It's pounding with excitementâ!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: What truly... incredible cheers—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. ...Right, Cheval-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to compete against you
with everything I had today, Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I'm so glad I got to race alongside such a strong Cheval-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san, you're...
You really are something else—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Me too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm... really glad you were here too.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "...You're amazing, Cheval-chan. Putting up a race like that against Kita-chan..."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
You... took on the challenge.
Holding your head high, looking straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're right—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: That's right... Me too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After engaging in a fiercely heated battle alongside
Kitasan Black that electrified the whole crowd...
Cheval Grand safely returned to us.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san...!
choice_data_list: Welcome back, Cheval! That was a great race—

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Cheval Grand-saaaan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Pyah... Ah, eh...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Immediately afterward, we were completely surrounded
by reporters who appeared all at once!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was certainly a magnificent run, so it's understandable she's the center of the press scrum... but Cheval Grand looks completely overwhelmed!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was an absolutely magnificent race!
Would you say that you delivered a run
you can be truly satisfied with!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Your older sister and younger sister were both in
the stands, weren't they!
Is the bond with your family a source of strength for you after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it was a sign of recognition for her abilities,
I felt it might be a bit too pitiful for her.
Thinking that, I almost stepped in to stop the reporters, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The a-answer... My answer, um.
I think... I've accepted it. Because... I gave it my all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And to my sisters... well.
I'm grateful. ...Always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is this also a sign of her resolve to become
a 'great Umamusume'? Feeling pleased, I decide
to watch over Cheval Grand for now."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!!
Next, we'd love to ask about your prospects
for your next race—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Having achieved such magnificent results in both the Hanshin Daishoten and the Tenno Sho (Spring), the fans must be watching with great anticipation!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, naturally, all eyes turn to the Grand Prix race...
We anticipate an entry in the Takarazuka Kinen,
would that be correct?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh!
T-The Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(T-The Spring Grand Prix...
Me, in a race like that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
What do you think...?! I'm sure the fans
are really looking forward to seeing Cheval Grand
perform together with the star Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
Show us another race like that!!
We'll be cheering for youuuuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Expectations...
Looking forward to... my race—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Woah—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san.
The "Takarazuka Kinen"... is a goal, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: How... is it...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand had asked me with such earnestness.
I give her a warm smile in return.
choice_data_list: If that's what you want to aim for, of course that's fine.
If that's what you want to aim for, then of course that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh...?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... um.
I...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I will aim for it. Next is...
the Takarazuka Kinen...!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand-san, Trainer-san,
thank you both so much for answering!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely make this a fantastic article...!
I'll do my absolute best to show off
all of Cheval Grand's charms!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... N-No.
I'm sorry, I was spacing out...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. I'm...
really not used to... people cheering for me
or having expectations."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It was always my big sister and little sister who stood out...
I was always just stuck in the corner where nobody could find me...
It's always been like that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still, I can hear the cheers properly now... and the loud voices are increasing, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well...
It's just, you know...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'm exhausted...
choice_data_list: For now, let's get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We've settled on the Takarazuka Kinen as our next target, but let's save the training talk for later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "For now, I decided to take good care of Cheval Grand, whose head was spinning from all the unfamiliar events."
